claim: With AWS Fargate on Amazon ECS you pay for the vCPU and memory resources that your containerized application requests, calculated from the time your container images are pulled until the task terminates, rounded up to the nearest second, with a minimum charge of one minute.

evidence.quote: AWS Fargate Launch Type Model: With AWS Fargate, you pay for the amount of vCPU and memory resources that your containerized application requests. vCPU and memory resources are calculated from the time your container images are pulled until the Amazon ECS Task terminates, rounded up to the nearest second. A minimum charge of one minute applies.
